title: Smiling Baby Girl in White Dress on Sled, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A square black-and-white snapshot of a cheerful baby girl seated on a wooden sled or rocker indoors. She wears a crisp white frock, soft baby shoes with white socks, and a tiny bow barrette pinned into her hair. In the background, a board decorated with a charming drawing of a cottage, flowers, clouds, and trees creates an impromptu backdrop, capturing the warmth and domestic simplicity of mid-century American family milestones.
